title: Culture of 16HBE14o- Cells
protocol: Remove 50 mL of volume from the bottle of MEM basal medium and discard.
Add 50 mL of fetal bovine serum (FBS) to the remaining volume of MEM.
Add 5 mL of 100X penicillin/streptomycin to the medium.
Mix thoroughly and label with the date and additives.
Warm media and prepare materials prior to obtaining a vial of cells from cryostorage.
Remove vial from liquid nitrogen (wearing eye protection) and thaw in 37°C water bath (1-2 min).
Add 24 mL of growth medium to a 50 mL conical tube then add the thawed cells and gently mix by inversion.
Pellet cells via centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Carefully aspirate the supernatant.
Gently resuspend the cells in 10 mL of pre-warmed growth medium and transfer into a 10 cm collagen coated tissue culture dish.
Incubate in a humidified 37 °C incubator with 5% CO₂ overnight.
Check cells the following day for attachment to the dish.
Replace medium to remove dead cells (rounded, unattached cells).
Culture at least three passages before using in experiments.
Pre-warm growth medium and PBS in a 37 °C water bath and a trypsin aliquot at room temperature (~30 minutes).
Aspirate the culture medium.
Rinse cells in 10 cm plates with 10 mL pre-warmed PBS, swirling gently (use 20 mL for 15 cm plates).
Aspirate the PBS wash.
Add 750 μL trypsin to the cells and spread evenly across the cell surface (for 10 cm plate, use 1.5 mL of trypsin for a 15 cm plate).
Place in 37 °C incubator for 4 minutes.
Use the palm of your hand to hit the side of dish to facilitate detachment.
Incubate until >95% of the cells are detached.
Tap dish to ensure cell detachment.
Add 12 mL medium to wash the surface of the dish.
Gently pipette and triturate once to break up large cell clumps.
Transfer washed cells to a 50 mL centrifuge tube.
Wash plate with an additional 12 mL of medium.
Collect and tritrate, then add to the cell suspension in step #7.
Centrifuge at 1,000 x g for 4 minutes to pellet cells.
Aspirate supernatant and resuspend in 12 mL of medium.
Prepare a 1:5 dilution in PBS (800 μL PBS + 200 μL cell suspension).
Count cells on a hemocytometer.
Dilute cells to 2.5 x 10^5 cells/mL in growth medium for plating.
Mix thoroughly by swirling and dispense the diluted cell suspension into collagen coated tissue culture dishes.
Incubate in a humidified incubator at 37 °C with 5% CO₂.
Prepare freezing medium.
Mix 50% FBS, 40% growth medium, and 10% DMSO to prepare the freezing medium.
Filter the freezing medium through a 0.2 μm syringe filter.
Determine the number of cells present.
Pellet cells by centrifugation at 1,000 x g for 3 minutes at room temperature.
Resuspend the cell pellet at a density of 3.0 x 10^6 cells/mL in freezing medium.
Aliquot the resuspended cells into cryovials (1 mL per vial).
Place the cryovials in a controlled cell freezing container filled with isopropyl alcohol to the indicated line.
Put the container in a -80 °C freezer overnight.
Put the frozen vials in liquid nitrogen storage.
